question: For this Codex lane-release candidate, is focused runner/Codex regression proof enough after a current-main refresh, or should merge wait for a live wedged Codex app-server and channel-delivery proof?
rationale: The code path is a valid bug fix candidate, but the remaining blocker is maintainer acceptance of proof strength and session/message-delivery risk rather than a narrow line-level defect.

options.title: Refresh And Accept Focused Proof
options.body: Refresh the PR against current main, rerun required checks, and accept the focused runner/Codex regression as sufficient for the lane-release contract.

options.title: Require Live Wedge Proof
options.body: Pause merge until a live or Crabbox Codex app-server wedge shows the lane release does not corrupt session state or user-visible delivery.

options.title: Close In Favor Of A New Branch
options.body: Close this stale replacement only if maintainers want a new current-main PR to reapply the same fix through the newer Codex app-server code.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Accept Focused Proof
recommendation.body: Refresh the PR against current main, rerun required checks, and accept the focused runner/Codex regression as sufficient for the lane-release contract.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc merged the adjacent native lane-release contract that this PR extends and is the strongest history-backed owner for the runner-side decision.
